final: WITH site_ratios AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat, AVG(m.facetresmm * 1.0 / m.geomdeltamm) AS site_ratio, COUNT(*) AS mesh_records FROM sites AS s JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE s.insurstat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.insurstat), status_averages AS (SELECT insurstat, AVG(site_ratio) AS status_ratio FROM site_ratios GROUP BY insurstat) SELECT sr.insurstat, AVG(sr.site_ratio) AS average_kept_ratio, SUM(sr.mesh_records) AS total_mesh_records, AVG(sr.site_ratio - sa.status_ratio) AS average_excess FROM site_ratios AS sr JOIN status_averages AS sa ON sa.insurstat = sr.insurstat WHERE sr.site_ratio > sa.status_ratio GROUP BY sr.insurstat
